info.title: Al Bahar Home & Living API
info.description: Al Bahar Home & Living REST API v1. Human-readable contract and conventions: docs/api/API_CONTRACT.md. All money values are decimal strings in QAR; times are ISO-8601 Asia/Qatar.

post.summary:
Registers (or refreshes) a push token of the phone app or of a browser. Idempotent: the same token again just refreshes the
row, and a token that was registered by someone else moves to the person calling now. For platform "web" the browser family
is read from the user agent; `app` says which web app asked (the store or the web version of the mobile app). The phone apps also
send `notification_permission` (granted | denied | not_asked): it is kept with the token and the dashboard uses it to tell the team
when a push would be accepted by Google but not shown. A value outside that list is refused (422) like any other unknown value

notification_permission.description: What the phone says about showing notifications; left out by older apps (then the stored answer stays as it is).

delete.summary: Turns off one of the caller's own tokens (sign-out on that phone or browser). A token of another person is ignored

post.summary:
The whole basket. A guest (or an app that has not signed in) sends `lines`; a signed-in customer may send them too, or leave them out and get
the promise for their own server cart (with its assembly choices, branch and address). A saved address is only used when it is the caller's own

get.summary: The promise for the signed-in customer's own cart (the same answer as `POST /cart/promise` without lines)

distance_m.description: Length of the full recording, not of the simplified line, so the figure does not shrink with the point limit.

post.summary:
The driver app's GPS ping. 422 when the fix itself is unusable (outside Qatar, in the future, older than
platform.tracking.max_fix_age_minutes); 200 with recorded=false and a reason when it is fine but not stored
(off_duty, rate_limited, duplicate, low_accuracy, out_of_order), so the app never retries those

get.summary: My jobs: scope=active (default) or history (last 30 finished; see {@see history()})
One of my jobs in full (opened from a notification, or to refresh an open window). 404 when it is not mine (any more)

My last 30 finished jobs, newest first. The short version of a job (order number, area, time, status, amount, items); a job finished more
than 24 hours ago no longer carries the customer's phone numbers or street (`redacted: true`)

Counts for the staff home: new, preparing, ready, waiting for a driver, out for delivery, drivers on duty. Besides the delivery counts (unchanged) it
carries the pickup counts (`pickup`), the branches the person works in (`branches`, for the branch picker of a manager of several) and what they
may do at this branch (`can`). See docs/api/STAFF_QUEUE.md

get.description:
Every row also carries its order clock, the customer's open cancellation request and what is left to pay (docs/api/STAFF_QUEUE.md). `page` / `per_page`
(1-100, default 50) page the list; `meta` says whether `next` exists. A caller that sends neither gets the first 100 rows as before.
get.summary:
Delivery orders of the branch by stage (new | preparing | ready | out | failed | all). A failed delivery stays visible so staff can bring it back.
An online order that is not paid yet is left out (it cannot be accepted: the dashboard hides it the same way). Every row carries its `type`
(`delivery`); with `include_pickup=1` the branch's pickup parts are listed too (type `pickup`; `ready` then also means `pickup_ready`), and without
the flag the answer is exactly what it always was. `type=delivery|pickup` narrows the list to one kind (pickup implies the flag)

Live fleet for the dashboard map and the staff app: the drivers on duty (branch-scoped) with last position, how old it is
(age_seconds / stale) and the job in hand

post.summary: Assign (or re-assign) a driver to a ready delivery order; creates the delivery when needed

Hand back a job that was given to him and that he has not accepted: `too_far`, `vehicle`, `shift_ending` or `other` (a short note is welcome).
The job goes back to waiting (or straight to the next driver in a branch that gives jobs out by itself, never to him again), the branch
managers are told, and it is written to the delivery's history and the audit log. A job he accepted cannot be handed back this way (409)

"I have arrived". Only the driver of the delivery, only while it is out for delivery; repeating it changes nothing. The customer is told
once. The driver's position is optional (a lift lobby has no GPS) and is kept in the delivery's history when it comes
